notes.title: Update ver. 1.1.0
notes.content:
Thank you for playing “FAIRY TAIL: Dungeons”.
The following update was made in ver. 1.1.0.

-------------------------

[b][Improvements & New Features][/b]

[b]- New Skills Added[/b]
Added a new "Magic Chain" that allows a free combination of selections.
With this update, existing Magic Chains will no longer appear outside the center of the skill grid determined by the amulet.
The new Magic Chain will always appear evenly when unlocking skills one space away from the center.

Added skills that activate through the use of Wizard Summon Cards or when Extra Attacks are triggered.

[b]- Enchantment Improvements[/b]
Added a feature to reroll effects by consuming Lacrima.

[b]- Magic Card Adjustments[/b]
Extensive balance adjustments and new effects added, mainly to Magic Cards with MP costs of 2 and 3, expanding build options and reducing reliance on RNG.
Adjustments for each character are as follows:

[b]<Natsu>[/b]
Balance adjustments to existing cards and the addition of new cards provide more support-focused build options.
Some high-cost cards have new debuff effects like the status ailment "Burning."

[b]<Lucy>[/b]
Significant balance adjustments to the effects of the Magic Card "Prayer" and some Celestial Spirit Magic.
Added a new buff effect, "Prayer," which enhances the effects of certain Celestial Summon Cards.
Changed the Magic Card "Luck" from a support type to a defense type and added a Block +5 effect.
Added "Status Effect Damage Amplification" to some high-cost cards.

[b]<Gray>[/b]
Extensive balance adjustments to existing cards and the addition of new cards provide more build options across different types.
Added effects that reduce or nullify the user's Block on cards that convert Block value to damage.
Some high-cost cards have new effects like "Debuff Duration Extension."
Added a new debuff effect, "Frostbite," to some high-cost cards.
Added a new buff effect, "Ice-Make Extra Attack" to some high-cost cards.

[b]<Erza>[/b]
Extensive balance adjustments to existing cards and the addition of new cards provide more support-focused build options.
Added a new buff effect, "Finisher" to the Magic Card "Flash" (guarantees the next attack will be a critical hit).
Some high-cost cards now include the status effect "Laceration."
Added a new buff effect, "Extra Attack Sword," to some high-cost cards.
Added "Status Effect Damage Amplification" to some high-cost cards.
Added "Status Effect Damage Activation" to some high-cost cards.

[b]<Wendy>[/b]
Changed the Magic Card "Focus" from a support type to a defense type and added a Block +5 effect.
Added a new debuff effect, "Razorwind," to some high-cost cards.

[b]<Common>[/b]
Added "Anti-Air" effects to some cards.

[b]- New Magic Cards Added[/b]
[b]Rally (Natsu):[/b] Grants Rally (nullifies block reduction from turn passing once) to the entire party, etc.
[b]Command (Erza):[/b] Grants Finisher to the entire party, etc.
[b]Strip Off (Gray):[/b] Grants Strip Off (doubles the effect of ATK Down and DEF Down debuffs) to the user, etc.
Several other cards have been added.
(All of these will be available after clearing the ending.)

[b]- Dodge Mechanic Changes[/b]
Changed to combine dodge chances for calculation.
When dodge is successful, all evasion buffs will be removed.

[b]- Skill Adjustments[/b]
Adjusted Magic Chain effects.
Adjusted the enhancement effects and costs of Magic Cards.

[b]- Effect Adjustments[/b]
Enhanced effects for successful stuns and dodge.

[b]- Rank Reward Adjustments[/b]
Adjusted the timing for adding amulet slots.
Third slot: Rank 41 -> 30 (Players between Rank 30-40 will automatically receive the third slot after the update.)
Fourth slot: Rank 83 -> 65 (Players between Rank 65-82 will automatically receive the fourth slot after the update.)

[b]- UI Adjustments[/b]
Changed action icons for enemy special attack turns and added effects.
Changed the enchantment icon for Extra Attacks and Normal Follow-up Attacks.
Shortened descriptions of some special effects in Magic Card descriptions and moved them to a separate section.


[b]- Monster Adjustments[/b]
Adjusted the balance of some monsters.
Added the "Levitation" buff to certain monsters.

[b]- Labyrinth Adjustments[/b]
Added new monster groups.

[b]- Difficulty Unlock[/b]
Unlocked ★★★★ difficulty for the Sealed Portal and Deep Labyrinth.

[b]- Nether Palace Balance Adjustments[/b]
Added new monster groups.
Adjusted so that buffs and debuffs for certain monsters are modified from specific floors onward.
With this adjustment, the difficulty beyond Floor 25 has been increased.

[b]- New Labyrinth Quests Added[/b]
Added new quests for the newly unlocked difficulty levels.
(Labyrinth Quests related to the Nether Palace must be completed again after the update.)

[b]- New Amulets Added[/b]
Added new rewards for the newly added quests.

[b]- Library Improvements[/b]
Optimized display processing.
Added idle animations for monsters.

[b]- New Enchantments Added[/b](Edited)
Nullifies Block Removal
Nullifies Block Halving
Ice-Make Extra Attack+
Extra Attack Sword+
Status Effect+

-------------------------

Thank you for your continued support of “FAIRY TAIL: Dungeons”.

notes.title: Announcement of Plans for Major Update
notes.content:
Thank you for playing “FAIRY TAIL: Dungeons”.

We are planning to release our first major update ver. 1.1.0 on October 18, so that players can enjoy “FAIRY TAIL Dungeons” even more.

We will make adjustments to expand build options and reduce reliance on RNG by revamping magic chains and enchantments, adding magic cards and skills, and significantly balancing existing magic cards.

Please look forward to the many other changes we have planned.

[Overview of update ver. 1.1.0]

- Revamp of Magic Chain
Added the ability to obtain magic chains in any combination for more flexible builds.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45134472/f681b64fd9095684b412721de4ac8b24904ab526.jpg[/img]

- Enchantment Revamp
Added reroll feature for more strategic build control
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45134472/f48c403c44401f23acb702119295e818090b8ee9.jpg[/img]

- Magic card additions and adjustments
New cards added to increase synergy in teams and significant balance adjustments, especially to high-cost cards
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45134472/8fbed7e407e2db0a4dcc29f89f786eea3732abb1.jpg[/img]

*Various other improvements are planned.

In addition, due to the positive feedback and expectations we have received from our players through Reviews and Discussions, we are also considering the following as ongoing updates after version 1.1.0.

-------------------------------------------------------
- Addition of more difficulty levels and magic cards
- Addition of magic cards of Haru, the main character of “RAVE” written by Hiro Mashima
- Addition of a labyrinth with daily challenge elements
- Addition of playable characters
-------------------------------------------------------

We will report on these items as soon as we have further information from November onward.

Thank you for your continued support of “FAIRY TAIL: Dungeons”.

New cards added to increase synergy in teams and significant balance adjustments, especially to high-cost cards

Addition of a labyrinth with daily challenge elements

notes.title: Update ver.1.0.9 & Notice of Currently Confirmed Bugs
notes.content:
Thank you for playing “FAIRY TAIL: Dungeons”.
The following update was made in ver. 1.0.9.

This update is designed to improve the quality of the playing experience,
This update includes significant balance adjustments, including changes to the initial deck.
While there are some downward adjustments, the overall balance has been adjusted upward.
----------
ver.1.0.9

[Renovations and additions]

-Adjustment of magic cards

Triple Strike(Natsu):Attack Increase +1(2T)
Rush(Lucy):Evasion(30%)(2T)
Triple Strike(Gray):Defense +1(2T)
Three Strikes (Erza): Attack +1 (2T)
Parry (Erza): attack +2 (1T) when damage halving effect is activated
Triple Strike(Wendy):Add evasion(30%)(2T)
Resolution: damage 5 changed to 3% of maximum strength value

-Add magic card

Luck: doubles the amount of evasive or critical buffs you get next
Focus: Increases the buff effect of the next Magic Card by 1 turn.

-Change of initial cards

Lucy: “Dodge” changed to “Luck
Wendy: “Dodge” changed to “Focus
Wendy: “Punch” changed to “Double Strike”.
(These changes will be applied when you start a new labyrinth after the update)

-Debuff Effects: Debuff blocking specifications have been changed.

Changed so that blocking a debuff will release it.

-Skill changes

The number of lacrimas required to learn the skills of attack increase and defense increase has been revised from 80 to 60
Adjusted the balance of the amount of magic chain effect for Natsu and Erza （modified the range of +- 0 throughout I~X)

-Addition of skills

Magic Enhance: increased power based on the amount of magic consumed

-Changed Deck Bonus Lv2

Magic card enhancement: modified to change the enhancement value for each magic power consumed

-Amulets changed

Adjustment of the effect of two amulets that change the magic card of Dodge in accordance with the change of “Dodge” in the initial deck

-Adjustment of the specifications of “Underworld Palace

Adjustment to compensate from a certain number of levels when the cancellation condition of a demon's special action is damage
Upper limit set for some demons' strength correction.

-Improved the faltering of the cursor icons

[Fixes]

-Fixed a bug that buffs enchanted on “Parry” and “Key to the Time Keeper” did not activate properly.

-Fixed a bug that the names of “Il Armor” and “Il Vernier” were reversed in English only.

-Fixed a bug that the magic card [Determination] for Wendy is the same as [Resolution] for the general magic card.

-Fixed a bug in which the description of Steam Achievements was “Enter” instead of “Clear” in English only.

-Fixed a bug in the help description of the Grand Battle of the Labyrinth in some languages, where it was stated that rank points could be earned.

(This is an error in the description. As with the “Grand Clash,” there is no result screen or points earned in the battle-only “Sealed Portal”).

----------
In addition, we would like to inform you of the following problems that we are currently confirming.
----------
[The following bugs are currently under investigation and their solutions.]

-After starting the game, the first auto-save does not work correctly and the save data is corrupted.
The save data will be saved to the following folder, but for the following folders,
Security software or device settings that do not allow the writing of files,
There are various possible causes such as security software, device settings that do not allow writing of files, insufficient capacity, etc.

%USERPROFILE%/AppData/LocalLow/ginolabo/FAIRY TAIL DUNGEONS

Please contact your device administrator or try another device.

-Inability to progress in certain boss battles

We have identified and resolved two of the three problems by ver. 1.0.8,
However, we have received reports that the problem continues to occur in rare cases.
After the occurrence of the problem, the game becomes inoperable even if the user resumes the game by selecting the suspended data from the title,
We apologize for the inconvenience, but we kindly ask you to cancel the resumption.
Please note that the problem may be caused by window mode or keyboard/mouse operation,
If this happens frequently, please try full screen mode and pad operation if possible.

----------
If you experience any of the above problems, we would appreciate it if you could report them to the following thread in the community.
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2305500/discussions/0/6149188808689001124/]https://steamcommunity.com/app/2305500/discussions/0/6149188808689001124/[/url]

We would appreciate it if you could provide us with the specs of your PC and a screenshot of the problem when it occurs when you report it.
Please also report the version, screen mode, keyboard/mouse operation/pad operation, and other information at the time the problem occurred.

We will notify you when the problem is resolved.

Thank you for your continued support of “FAIRY TAIL: Dungeons”.

notes.title: Update ver.1.0.6 & Notice of Currently Confirmed Bugs
notes.content:
Thank you for playing “FAIRY TAIL: Dungeons”.
The following update was made in ver. 1.0.6.
----------
ver.1.0.6
- Fixed that amulets for characters not on the team do not appear during the “Labyrinth Depths” strategy.
- Added 6 new amulets that appear in place of amulets for characters not on the team during “Labyrinth Depths”.
- Fixed that magic cards do not overlap with the rest of the deck when replenishing the deck during battles.
- Fixed some translated texts.
- Adjusted the strength of some monsters that appear in the end content “Nether Palace".
- Fixed a bug that affected the effects of some amulets on certain magic cards.
- Fixed a bug where the pad would vibrate even if the vibration was turned off in the options.
----------

In addition, we would like to inform you of the following bugs that we are currently confirming.
----------
Bugs that occur in certain boss battles
1. After the battle starts, if a specific attack is prevented with a specific magic card, progression will stop.
2. Progression stops after the battle starts.
3. Progression stops after the battle ends.
Of the above, the fix for 1. has been completed in ver. 1.0.4.
We are still investigating the issue of 2. and 3. in terms of both hardware and software.
----------
If you encounter any of the above problems, we would appreciate it if you could report them to the following thread in the community.
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2305500/discussions/0/6149188808689001124/]https://steamcommunity.com/app/2305500/discussions/0/6149188808689001124/[/url]
We would appreciate it if you could provide us with the specs of your PC and a screenshot of the time the problem occurred.
Please also indicate whether the background of the game is moving or not.
If you are using a mouse or keyboard, please also report whether or not there were any clicks or special keystrokes when the problem occurred.

We will notify you when the problem is resolved.

Thank you for your continued support of “FAIRY TAIL: Dungeons”.

notes.title: TIPS
notes.content:
Thank you for playing “FAIRY TAIL: Dungeons”.

We would like to explain some of the specifications that we receive many inquiries about.
We hope you will find it useful in your strategies.

----------

1. Targeting Specifications
If you want to select any enemy and activate a magic card,
(1) Select target, (2) Select card, (3) Activate, and so on.
(One enemy is automatically selected at the beginning of your turn.)
You can also check which card will be activated against which target in the upper right corner of the screen.

----------

2. Variations of special actions of demons
As described in the help section for more details, there are some buffs granted by special actions performed by some demons.
There are two types: those that can be canceled when conditions are met, and counter types that are triggered when conditions are met.
You can determine this by the shape of the buff icon, or check the detailed description section of the buff icon for detailed conditions.

----------

3. Regarding the absence of a member on the team that is a condition for canceling a demon's special action
Due to a recent update, when there are conditions regarding magic cards for certain characters during team battles,
The magic card will be automatically adjusted so that the magic card can be used by a character who exists in the team.

----------

4. Countermeasure for “Number of Magic Cards Used” as a Cancellation Condition for Demon's Special Action
Sometimes it is difficult to get the “number of magic cards used” as a cancellation condition for special actions of demons, even if you make full use of redrawing,
However, it is possible to use “Magic cards with a magic cost of 0 to call a mage”, which can be obtained by accomplishing a specific event, or to use “cards with a follow-up effect” to attack.
However, it is easier to achieve the cancellation condition by increasing the number of attacks with “cards with a follow-up effect”.

----------

5. Evasion Specifications
Each buff icon of evasion has a different probability, and when attacked by a demon
When you are attacked by a demon, one evasion is determined for each icon. (In other words, the probability of evasion is not the total value of the buffs.)
Also, when evasion is triggered, one buff icon with successful evasion will disappear, regardless of the number of turns remaining.

----------

6. Damage is reduced to 1
In some demons, an effect given at the start of battle forces the damage of certain cards to be reduced to 1.
Targeting an enemy other than that one will also update the card's power.
Please check the details section of the buff icon for more information.
In addition, a recent update has changed the buffs for demons granted at the start of battle by displaying effects to make them easier to gaze at.

----------

7. Cloud saving
We are currently prioritizing the response to various issues. We are considering implementing this feature, so please wait for a while.

----------

Thank you for your continued support of “FAIRY TAIL: Dungeons”.
